rationale: Only a single 5-minute candle of price history is available (session just opened at 09:31 ET), providing no actionable structure — no EMAs, no ATR, and no prior trend context to define a setup in either direction. The bid/ask spread of 88.5 bps creates an immediate structural disadvantage that exceeds any edge derivable from the limited data, and price sitting at 100% of the early range with no confirmation of continuation or rejection makes the risk/reward undefined. Elevated relative volume (3.12x) is noted but insufficient alone to justify entry without a clearer setup.
